information.description:
Arasaka snipers often have missions to protect high-value clients or VIPs from afar, and have an exceptional track record at doing so. Their preference of rifles does tend to slow down their fire rate, but they only need one shot to eliminate most threats.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Arasaka).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

One of the oldest weapons made by Arasaka from the early 2000s. These days it's a rare sight on the street, as it's a pistol that is — no point in sugarcoating it — outdated and difficult to maintain. Spare parts for it are no longer manufactured, and it's no longer compatible with most standard weapon mods. That being said, should it be held up to someone's head and have its trigger is pulled, the end result will still be as conclusive as with any modern firearm.

Cost: 100eb (Premium)

Class: Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Armor-Piercing Ammunition bought for this weapon costs 20eb (Everyday) per 10, and can only be used by this weapon.

Range: Pistol

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Arasaka continues to deny claims that the Nobunaga is a modified copy of Tsunami Arms’ Ashura. They’re lying, but who can blame them? This extensive rebuild rips out the Ashura’s smart-guided gyrojet mechanism in favor of a bolt action that loads custom nano-explosive tipped munitions. For skilled sharpshooters, a single Nobunaga can forge an empire.

Cost: 3,500eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Scout Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 8 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Extended Magazine, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Power Rebuild), Smartgun Link, Variable Scope Mount (w/ Infrared Nightvision Scope, Long Scope, & Sniping Scope) • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Armor-Piercing Ammunition (500eb (Expensive) per 10), which also functions as High Precision and Incendiary Ammunition. After this weapon is fired, an Action is required to work its bolt before it can be fired again.

Range: Scout Rifle
Pre-installed: Extended Magazine, Magrail Kit (w/ Bipod & Power Rebuild), Smartgun Link, Variable Scope Mount (w/ Infrared Nightvision Scope, Long Scope, & Sniping Scope) (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
Light version of an Armorjack for your head. No armor penalty.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
Plating on your hand which allows you to utilise Smartguns. Requires a neural link.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

New-wave optical gear with improved resolution and visual fidelity.

Smart Glasses with pre-installed Image Enhance, which does not consume any Option Slots and cannot be removed. Unlike regular Smart Glasses, these cannot be modified to use an alternate frame or style, and obscure the user’s eyes from external view.

Type: Cybereye (Foundational)
Install: Mall
Humanity Loss: None
Option Slots: uses 1, provides 2

Foundry notes:

  • Worn, not surgically installed: no Humanity Loss.
  • The pre-installed Image Enhance is described here rather than installed as a separate item.
